pages.text: The $(thing)Drying Rack$() is one block tall and holds one 16-leaf inventory. Valid raw leaves can enter from the $(thing)top or horizontal sides$(); bottom insertion is blocked. A hopper underneath can extract only when the batch has completely finished curing.

Rack automation still obeys batch rules: leaves must match the stored leaf's exact item/components, the rack holds at most 16, and insertion is blocked once progress reaches 10%. Bottom-facing vanilla hoppers pull only finished output; compatible Forge/Create logistics use the rack's validated handlers without bypassing those rules.
pages.title: Drying Rack
Industrial Rack
pages.text: The $(thing)Industrial Drying Rack$() is automation-only and occupies two real block levels sharing one 32-leaf inventory. Compatible automation can address either level, with valid input from above or horizontal sides; bottom insertion is blocked. Both the lower and upper rack levels must receive matching qualifying airflow from two distinct Encased Fans. Plain airflow normally Air Cures, or assists Sun Curing when the normal sunlight requirements are also met.

pages.title: Production Monitor
pages.text: Place the $(item)Production Monitor$() with its front face pointing at the adjacent transport it should read; it counts confirmed throughput without moving items. It supports Create Belts, Funnels and Chutes plus vanilla Hoppers. The ghost Filter can be set in the menu or directly on the operator-facing filter target: hover the target for a Create-style highlight, use an item/Create Filter/Attribute Filter to copy it without consuming the stack, or use an empty hand there to clear it. Items mode counts item quantity; Stacks measures Create-style 64-item stack-equivalents; Transfers counts successful transfer operations.

pages.title: Monitor Targets & Output
pages.text: Set a numeric target, then choose Keep Counting, Stop Counting, or Reset Count. Reset Count preserves overflow. Output may be None, a Pulse per target crossing, or Hold until reset; Reset Count + Hold becomes Pulse. Manual Reset keeps the rolling rate, and optional External Reset reacts only to a rising redstone edge. A Comparator reports progress. Create Display Links can read Count/Target, rolling Rate, or Status and refresh those monitor values about once per second; Tobacconist's Spectacles/Create Goggles show the same live telemetry in-world.

The $(thing)Hookah$() exposes its three-slot item handler to Forge/Create automation. Tall two-block Hookahs resolve both halves to the same lower master inventory, so Funnels, Hoppers, Mechanical Arms, Packagers/Stock Links, and Display Links can connect at either level. Inputs remain validated per slot: fuel, Shisha Tobacco, and Water/Dirty Hookah Water.
pages.title: Hookah

pages.text: The $(thing)Tobacco Barrel$() holds up to 64 compatible cured leaves or loose tobacco and exposes validated automation. Extraction preserves tobacco metadata; actively fermenting batches remain protected from premature automated extraction. Display Links can also report the current batch count out of 64.
pages.title: Barrel
Other Processing Blocks
pages.text: The Drying Racks, Tobacco Barrel, Flue Firebox, and Hookah expose validated Forge/Create item automation where appropriate. Automation never bypasses the blocks' normal input, batch, curing, fuel, or slot rules.

pages.title: Hanging Tobacco
pages.text: Traditional hanging 16-leaf bunches are not inventory machines. Hoppers, funnels, Mechanical Arms, and Display Links cannot insert, extract, or read them. Break the bunch to recover its leaves. Environmental Create fan assistance can still accelerate a valid cure.

pages.title: Tobacco Crates
pages.text: Tobacco Crates are packaged blocks rather than live inventories. Their nine stored units are recovered by breaking the crate; individual contents are not exposed to hopper/Create logistics.
